analysis.title: Swiss Number Cruncher UBS Group: UBS posts another strong performance and exceeds most expectations
key_insights: ZKB says UBS delivered a very good 3Q26 result that largely exceeded consensus. The beat was mainly in NCL (Non-core and Legacy), which more than offset Group Items (GI).

ZKB calls the UBS investment case increasingly attractive but keeps a Market Perform rating. It cites ongoing uncertainty and volatile share reactions to the political process on capital requirements.
UBS expects to beat its targets of underlying RoCET1 of about 15% by end 2026 and underlying CIR below 70%. The 3Q26 figures are already 16.7% and 68.7%.
UBS expects to complete the current CHF 3 bn share buyback by 4Q26. It expects to end the year with a CET1 ratio of about 14%, including potential deferral for the initial tranche of 2027 buybacks.
UBS hopes for a regulatory solution on capital that is not unduly burdensome, and reaffirms its diversified business model with global and regional presence.

3Q26 adjusted operating income was USD 13,387 mn versus USD 12,199 mn a year earlier, 3.5% above consensus. NCL was USD 0.8 bn above consensus, mainly from a settlement of legacy liabilities from legal disputes.
Bond buybacks (USD -0.3 bn net loss) and USD 0.3 bn of negative hedge effects hit Group Items revenue. GI was USD 0.1 bn below consensus on an adjusted basis and USD 0.3 bn on reported revenue.
Adjusted pre-tax profit was USD 4,077 mn, up 13.6% y/y and 9.2% above consensus but only 2% above ZKB's estimate. Reported pre-tax profit was USD 3,587 mn, up 26.9% y/y and 2.0% above consensus.
GWM underlying pre-tax profit excluding litigation was slightly below ZKB and consensus. PC, IB and AM were better than expected, and NCL was significantly better on higher revenues.
Consolidated profit after minorities of USD 2,690 mn was 0.6% below consensus because the effective tax rate was 2 pp higher than expected.
GWM net new money of USD 55 bn beat ZKB's USD 36 bn estimate, including USD 17 bn from GWM Americas. Net new funds (NNFGA) were USD 13 bn.

market_movers.rationale: ZKB keeps Market Perform after a strong 3Q26 beat. It sees the case as increasingly attractive but flags volatile reactions to the capital requirements debate.

earnings_insights: UBS 3Q26 adjusted operating income USD 13,387 mn reported vs ZKB estimate USD 13,165 mn and consensus USD 12,929 mn (UBS survey, Oct 2026).
UBS 3Q26 adjusted pre-tax profit USD 4,077 mn reported vs ZKB estimate USD 3,996 mn and consensus USD 3,733 mn.
UBS 3Q26 consolidated profit after minorities USD 2,690 mn reported vs ZKB estimate USD 2,782 mn and consensus USD 2,707 mn.
UBS 3Q26 adjusted costs USD 9,197 mn reported vs ZKB estimate USD 9,041 mn and consensus USD 9,067 mn. The adjusted cost-to-income ratio was 68.7%.
risk_factors: Ongoing uncertainty and volatile share reactions to the political process around Swiss capital requirements for UBS.
Regulatory solution on capital could prove unduly burdensome.
Group Items drag from bond buybacks and hedge losses.
